title: Option to open System Monitor with left-click, rather than the expanded view
line: System Monitor widgets in a panel can now be set to open the System Monitor app when clicked, instead of showing their popup.
explanation: The compact (panel) representation of the System Monitor widgets always toggled the details popup on left-click; the app could only be opened with a middle-click or the "Open System Monitor…" context menu entry, which most users never find. The change adds a General/openSystemMonitorOnClick setting (default off) with a "When clicked: Show details / Open System Monitor" choice at the end of the Appearance page, twinned with the face's form layout and shown only for panel widgets; when it is on, left-click calls Plasmoid.openSystemMonitor() instead of toggling the popup.

commits.message:
applets/systemmonitor: add option to open System Monitor on click

Clicking a System Monitor widget in a panel always opened its popup, and
the app could only be reached with a middle-click or the context menu. A
new Appearance option lets left-click open System Monitor instead.

BUG: 444151

patches.diff:
From bf2bf118d1b014ae7e7cb1d02f64d44b6b2c0e3f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 22:55:51 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/systemmonitor: add option to open System Monitor on
 click

Clicking a System Monitor widget in a panel always opened its popup, and
the app could only be reached with a middle-click or the context menu. A
new Appearance option lets left-click open System Monitor instead.

BUG: 444151
---
 .../package/contents/config/main.xml          |  6 +++
 .../contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml     |  8 ++-
 .../contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml   | 52 +++++++++++++++----
 3 files changed, 56 insertions(+), 10 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/config/main.xml b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/config/main.xml
index a7d3191ceb..eeecbfb2a8 100644
--- a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -12,6 +12,12 @@
     </entry>
   </group>
 
+  <group name="General">
+    <entry name="openSystemMonitorOnClick" type="Bool">
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
+  </group>
+
   <group name="Sensors">
     <entry name="totalSensor" type="String">
     </entry>
diff --git a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 6e9ef5b4da..2b6c965045 100644
--- a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -57,6 +57,12 @@ Control {
     MouseArea {
         parent: chartFace
         anchors.fill: parent
-        onClicked: root.expanded = !root.expanded
+        onClicked: {
+            if (Plasmoid.configuration.openSystemMonitorOnClick) {
+                Plasmoid.openSystemMonitor()
+            } else {
+                root.expanded = !root.expanded
+            }
+        }
     }
 }
diff --git a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
index 8b5c15e4c2..a60ac2fdd5 100644
--- a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
@@ -7,15 +7,21 @@
 */
 
 import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
 
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
+import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
 KCM.SimpleKCM {
     id: root
 
     signal configurationChanged
 
+    property alias cfg_openSystemMonitorOnClick: openSystemMonitorRadio.checked
+
     function saveConfig() {
         configUi.saveConfig()
         Plasmoid.faceController.reloadConfig()
@@ -28,18 +34,46 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
     // Kirigami.ScrollablePage which breaks if we override the contentItem. So
     // instead use a placeholder item and reparent the config UI into that item,
     // making sure to bind the required properties so sizing is correct.
-    Item {
-        id: contents
+    ColumnLayout {
+        spacing: 0
+
+        Item {
+            id: contents
+
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            implicitWidth: root.configUi.implicitWidth
+            implicitHeight: root.configUi.implicitHeight
+
+            children: root.configUi
+
+            Binding {
+                target: root.configUi
+                property: "width"
+                value: contents.width
+            }
+        }
+
+        Kirigami.FormLayout {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            visible: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Planar
+            twinFormLayouts: root.configUi
 
-        implicitWidth: root.configUi.implicitWidth
-        implicitHeight: root.configUi.implicitHeight
+            QQC2.ButtonGroup {
+                id: clickActionGroup
+            }
 
-        children: root.configUi
+            QQC2.RadioButton {
+                Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label", "When clicked:")
+                text: i18nc("@option:radio what clicking the widget does", "Show details")
+                checked: !openSystemMonitorRadio.checked
+                QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: clickActionGroup
+            }
 
-        Binding {
-            target: root.configUi
-            property: "width"
-            value: contents.width
+            QQC2.RadioButton {
+                id: openSystemMonitorRadio
+                text: i18nc("@option:radio what clicking the widget does", "Open System Monitor")
+                QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: clickActionGroup
+            }
         }
     }
 
--
